brief:
A colonizer shot and injured a Palestinian worker near Umm Qissa in Masafer Yatta, southern occupied West Bank, on Wednesday, IMEMC News reported. The incident occurred as settlers intensified operations in the area.

Settlers also blocked roads and burned land in the region during the same period, compounding tensions in the territory where Palestinians face regular confrontations with Israeli colonists.
dek: A colonizer shot and injured a Palestinian worker near Umm Qissa in Masafer Yatta, in the southern occupied West Bank, on Wednesday.
title: Settler shoots Palestinian worker in occupied West Bank
